meta.title: Control retórico
meta.goal: Ya puedes usar énfasis, inversión tras adverbios negativos (barely, not only, under no circumstances) y fronting con control retórico.

cards.title: Control retórico: qué expresa
cards.lede: Esta lección te ayuda a usar énfasis e inversión avanzada con precisión y sin traducir palabra por palabra.

rows.value: What matters is... / It was X that...
Were it not for... / Had they known...

tip.label: Objetivo:
tip.body: reconocer la intención y elegir correctamente énfasis e inversión avanzada en situaciones reales.

cards.title: La estructura que debes recordar
cards.lede: Observa la forma completa antes de producir tus propios ejemplos.

rows.value: What matters is... / It was X that...

cards.title: Ejemplos naturales
cards.lede: Lee cada ejemplo como una unidad completa y fíjate en la posición de las palabras.

rows.value: What I need is more time.
Under no circumstances should you respond.
Were it not for her help, we'd have failed.

cards.title: Cómo cambia el significado
cards.lede: La elección depende de la intención, la cantidad, el tiempo o el registro.

columns.label: cleft sentences
columns.rule: What matters is... / It was X that...
examples: What I need is more time.

columns.label: fronting
examples: Under no circumstances should you respond.

cards.title: Evita este calco
cards.lede: Compara la versión incorrecta con una forma natural y gramatical.

lines.text: Under no circumstances you should leave.
Under no circumstances should you leave.

cards.title: Decisión en cuatro pasos
cards.lede: Usa esta lista para comprobar tu frase antes de continuar.

rows.value: Elige la forma adecuada de énfasis e inversión avanzada.
Revisa sujeto, verbo, número y tiempo.
Lee la frase completa y evita traducir literalmente.

tip.label: Práctica:
tip.body: crea una frase personal con cada patrón y léela en voz alta.

quiz.q: ___ it not for the delay, we'd be finished.
quiz.explain: La respuesta correcta aplica la regla central de énfasis e inversión avanzada.

options: Under no circumstances you should leave.
Under no circumstances should you leave.
quiz.explain: La segunda opción usa la estructura y el orden correctos.

quiz.q: ¿Qué conviene revisar al usar énfasis e inversión avanzada?
options: La intención, la estructura y el contexto.
Solo la traducción literal al español.
quiz.explain: Una frase natural depende del significado, la forma y el contexto, no de traducir palabra por palabra.

transform.source: I have rarely experienced such exceptional hospitality.
transform.instruction: Reescribe comenzando con Seldom para dar énfasis retórico.
accept: Seldom have I experienced such exceptional hospitality.

transform.source: You must not reveal this confidential password under any circumstances.
transform.instruction: Reescribe comenzando con Under no circumstances.
accept: Under no circumstances should you reveal this confidential password.
Under no circumstances must you reveal this confidential password.

transform.source: We need to address the underlying causes of this failure.
transform.instruction: Reescribe como oración hendida (cleft sentence) con What.
accept: What we need to address is the underlying causes of this failure.
What we need to address are the underlying causes of this failure.

transform.source: He not only completed the marathon, but he also broke the national record.
transform.instruction: Reescribe comenzando con Not only para enfatizar su logro.
accept: Not only did he complete the marathon, but he also broke the national record.
Rarely have I seen such dedication and passion displayed in a team environment.

chunks: was not the policy change itself,
but the abrupt manner in which
accept: What surprised everyone most was not the policy change itself, but the abrupt manner in which it was announced.
Only by maintaining strict discipline can the research institute ensure reliable experimental outcomes.

correct.sentence: Scarcely had the keynote begun when the power went out.
accept: Scarcely had the keynote begun when the power went out.

correct.sentence: Under no circumstances you should sign the contract without legal counsel.
accept: Under no circumstances should you sign the contract without legal counsel.
correct.explanation: La inversión requiere auxiliar antes del sujeto: should you sign.

correct.sentence: What surprised the investigators was the complete lack of oversight.
accept: What surprised the investigators was the complete lack of oversight.

correct.sentence: Not only she arrived late, but she also forgot her presentation.
accept: Not only did she arrive late, but she also forgot her presentation.
correct.explanation: Not only en posición inicial exige inversión: did she arrive.

correct.sentence: Hardly had they reached the summit when a blizzard struck.
accept: Hardly had they reached the summit when a blizzard struck.
correct.explanation: Hardly had + participio ... when es una estructura enfática clásica y correcta.

personalize.promptEs: Reflexiona sobre tu trayectoria profesional o académica. Expresa dos ideas enfáticas sobre tus principios usando una inversión negativa y una hendida con What.
personalize.starter: What matters most in my career is integrity. Under no circumstances would I
personalize.hintEs: Incluye una frase con 'What...' y otra con 'Under no circumstances...' o 'Rarely...'

personalize.promptEs: Expresa una convicción ética fuerte sobre el liderazgo o la tecnología usando inversión y cleft.
personalize.starter: What concerns me most about modern technology is privacy. Seldom have we
personalize.hintEs: Combina una estructura de hendidura (What...) con inversión (Seldom have I/we...)

personalize.promptEs: Describe un momento de aprendizaje revelador en tu vida usando inversión negativa y hendidura.
personalize.starter: What taught me the most was that unexpected failure. Never had I
